summary: Tested post-game review completion flow for ChessGuru. All features working: POST /api/lab/{game_id}/complete-review endpoint marks game reviewed and returns summary + next_game, Review Complete Overlay appears with checkmark/title/lesson/next game button, Coach's Pick rotates after completing review, reviewed counter updates, 'Done reviewing' button hidden for already reviewed games.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/lab/{game_id}/complete-review endpoint correctly saves review_stats (concepts_learned, drills_solved, tabs_visited, moves_viewed, total_moves)
Endpoint returns summary with lesson_label, lesson, takeaway from coach_summary and decryption_v5_data.core_lesson
Endpoint returns next_game with game_id, opponent, result, opening for the next unreviewed game
ReviewCompleteOverlay component shows checkmark, 'Review complete' title, lesson summary, and appropriate CTA buttons
'Next game: vs {opponent}' button appears when there are more unreviewed games
'Back to Lab' button appears when completing the last unreviewed game
'Go to Lab queue' link always present for navigation back to /lab
'Done reviewing' button correctly hidden for already reviewed games (conditional render based on game.reviewed)
Coach's Pick on /lab correctly rotates to next unreviewed game after completing a review
Reviewed counter (X/Y reviewed) updates correctly after completing a review

success_rate.backend: 100% (9 passed, 4 skipped - skipped due to all games being reviewed during test)

seed_data_creation: Used existing 5 seeded test games: vs GrandMaster42 (reviewed), BlitzKing99 (unreviewed), QuietPawn (unreviewed), SicilianFan (reviewed), EndgameNerd (reviewed)
